blocks.text: Introduction to Val and Var
In Kotlin, val and var are used to declare variables. The main difference between them is that val is used for immutable variables, while var is used for mutable variables.
Immutable variables, declared with val, cannot be changed once they are assigned a value. On the other hand, mutable variables, declared with var, can be changed after they are assigned a value.
